text: Sorry if this is silly, i'm a childminder and one of the girls i look after is 11, she's got a temp of 38.7. She has dark skin so I wasnt sure if i was seeing things but I think theres little spots, I looked on her palms and inside her lower eyelids where its paler and theres tiny dark red dots there. I pressed a glass on her hand and I think they didnt go away, still there through the glass. Also she hasnt been for a poo in three days and shes pretty grumpy about that. Not sure if I'm overreacting, her mum is on her way.
